title: Finance, Business & Asset Management
sub: Markets, funds, risk and the language of wealth management.

cards.def:
Investments paying regular, predictable returns such as bonds
हिंदी: निश्चित आय वाले निवेश
examples: Fixed income provides stability to the portfolio.
Retired people often prefer fixed income over shares.
Fixed income funds did well when interest rates fell.
My portfolio is thirty percent fixed income.

cards.def:
A loan to a company or government that pays interest
हिंदी: बॉन्ड
examples: The bond matures in ten years.
The government issued a bond to fund new highways.
Bond prices usually fall when interest rates rise.
She bought a tax-free bond for steady income.

cards.def:
The income return on an investment
हिंदी: प्रतिफल
examples: The yield on government bonds fell last week.
The dividend yield on this stock is about three percent.
Higher yield usually means higher risk.
Investors compare the yield before choosing a bond.

cards.def:
The interest payment made on a bond
हिंदी: बॉन्ड का ब्याज भुगतान
examples: The bond pays a five percent annual coupon.
The coupon is paid twice a year.
A higher coupon makes the bond more attractive.
Zero-coupon bonds pay no interest until maturity.

cards.def:
The date when a financial instrument becomes payable
हिंदी: परिपक्वता तिथि
examples: The instrument reaches maturity in March.
My fixed deposit reaches maturity next month.
Short maturity bonds are less sensitive to rate changes.
At maturity, the investor gets the full amount back.

cards.def:
Spreading investments to reduce risk
हिंदी: निवेश का विविधीकरण
examples: Diversification protects against a single market falling.
Diversification means not putting all your eggs in one basket.
My adviser recommended diversification across gold, bonds and shares.
Diversification reduced our losses during the crash.

cards.def:
The distribution of funds among different investments
हिंदी: धन का वितरण
examples: Our allocation to equities is sixty percent.
Review your asset allocation every year.
Young investors can have a higher allocation to equity.
The fund increased its allocation to banking shares.

cards.def:
To adjust a portfolio back to its target mix
हिंदी: पोर्टफ़ोलियो को लक्ष्य अनुपात में लाना
examples: The fund rebalances at the end of every quarter.
I rebalance my portfolio every March.
After the rally, we need to rebalance towards bonds.
Rebalancing forces you to sell high and buy low.

cards.def:
A standard against which performance is measured
हिंदी: तुलना का मानक सूचकांक
examples: The fund outperformed its benchmark index by two percent.
Nifty 50 is the benchmark index for many Indian funds.
Compare your fund's return with its benchmark index.
Few active funds beat their benchmark index over ten years.

cards.def:
To achieve worse returns than expected
हिंदी: अपेक्षा से कमज़ोर प्रदर्शन करना
examples: The sector underperformed after the rate announcement.
My mutual fund underperformed the market last year.
Tech stocks underperformed when rates went up.
If a fund keeps underperforming, consider switching.

cards.def:
The gain or loss on an investment
हिंदी: निवेश पर लाभ/हानि
examples: The annual return was eight percent.
The return on my fixed deposit is seven percent.
Past returns don't guarantee future performance.
Real estate gave a good return in that area.

cards.def:
The level of risk an investor is willing to accept
हिंदी: जोखिम सहने की क्षमता
examples: Her low risk appetite favours bonds.
Young investors usually have a higher risk appetite.
The adviser asked questions to measure my risk appetite.
His risk appetite dropped after he had children.

cards.def:
The degree of price fluctuation
हिंदी: मूल्य में उतार-चढ़ाव
examples: Market volatility rose after the announcement.
Small-cap stocks have higher volatility than large caps.
Volatility increases before elections.
Don't panic over short-term volatility.

cards.def:
How easily an asset can be converted into cash
हिंदी: नकदी में बदलने की आसानी
examples: Low liquidity makes the bond hard to sell quickly.
A savings account offers high liquidity.
Keep some liquidity for emergencies.
Liquidity dried up during the financial crisis.

cards.def:
Not easily sold or converted to cash
हिंदी: आसानी से नकद में न बदलने वाला
examples: Real estate is an illiquid asset.
Land is illiquid; it can take months to sell.
Illiquid investments should be a small part of your portfolio.
Some small company shares are illiquid and hard to trade.

cards.def:
The amount of money at risk in an investment
हिंदी: जोखिम में लगी राशि
examples: Our exposure to emerging markets is limited.
The fund reduced its exposure to real estate.
Too much exposure to one stock is risky.
Check your exposure to foreign currencies.

cards.def:
To reduce risk by making an offsetting investment
हिंदी: जोखिम से बचाव करना
examples: The firm hedges currency risk using forward contracts.
Exporters hedge against changes in the dollar rate.
Gold is often used to hedge against inflation.
The airline hedged fuel prices for the next year.

cards.def:
A financial contract whose value depends on another asset
हिंदी: व्युत्पन्न अनुबंध
examples: Derivatives are used to manage price risk.
Derivatives can reduce risk or increase it.
Beginners should avoid trading derivatives.
The bank lost money on complex derivatives.

cards.def:
Contracts to buy or sell an asset at a future date and price
हिंदी: वायदा अनुबंध
examples: Oil futures rose sharply this morning.
Farmers use futures to lock in prices for their crops.
Trading futures needs a margin deposit.
Gold futures fell after the dollar strengthened.

cards.def:
A contract giving the right to buy or sell at a set price
हिंदी: विकल्प अनुबंध
examples: He bought an option to protect against a fall.
A call option lets you buy shares at a fixed price.
The option expires worthless if the price doesn't move.
Options trading is risky for beginners.

cards.def:
A basic raw material that is traded
हिंदी: वस्तु / कमोडिटी
examples: Gold is the most widely traded commodity.
Crude oil is the most important commodity for India's imports.
Commodity prices rose because of the drought.
Silver is both a commodity and an investment.

cards.def:
A unique code used to recognise an instrument
हिंदी: पहचान कोड
examples: ISIN is a global identifier for securities.
Each share has a unique identifier on the exchange.
The trade failed because the identifier was wrong.
Map every vendor identifier to our internal code.

cards.def:
An event by a company affecting its shares, such as a split
हिंदी: कंपनी द्वारा की गई शेयर संबंधी कार्रवाई
examples: Corporate actions must be applied to historical prices.
Dividends and bonus issues are common corporate actions.
The corporate action changed the number of shares we held.
Check corporate actions before comparing old prices.

cards.def:
Dividing existing shares into more shares
हिंदी: शेयर विभाजन
examples: The stock split doubled the number of shares.
After the stock split, each share cost half as much.
A stock split makes shares more affordable for small investors.
The company announced a one-to-five stock split.

cards.def:
One company purchasing another
हिंदी: अधिग्रहण
examples: The acquisition was completed last quarter.
The acquisition made it the largest bank in the country.
Employees were worried about jobs after the acquisition.
The startup's acquisition by a tech giant made headlines.

cards.def:
Prices and related information about financial instruments
हिंदी: बाज़ार संबंधी मूल्य डेटा
examples: Market data arrives from dozens of vendors.
Market data shows the share price every second.
The bank pays a lot for real-time market data.
Bad market data can lead to wrong trading decisions.

cards.def:
Static information describing instruments and entities
हिंदी: संदर्भ डेटा
examples: Reference data ensures consistency across systems.
Reference data includes company names and sector codes.
A team maintains reference data for all instruments.
Wrong reference data caused errors in the monthly report.

cards.def:
A continuous stream of prices from a source
हिंदी: मूल्यों की निरंतर आपूर्ति
examples: The price feed was delayed by ten minutes.
The app shows live prices from the exchange price feed.
We switched to a backup price feed during the outage.
Monitor the price feed for gaps and delays.

cards.def:
A revised price replacing an earlier incorrect one
हिंदी: संशोधित मूल्य
examples: Vendors send a corrected price when errors are found.
The fund's value changed after the corrected price arrived.
Reports must use the corrected price, not the original one.
Flag every corrected price for the audit trail.

cards.def:
Relating to the close of the trading day
हिंदी: दिन के अंत से संबंधित
examples: End-of-day prices are loaded by midnight.
The end-of-day report goes to managers at seven.
End-of-day balances must match the bank statement.
We run end-of-day checks before closing the books.

cards.def:
Occurring within a single trading day
हिंदी: दिन के भीतर
examples: Intraday prices update every minute.
Intraday traders buy and sell on the same day.
The share had a big intraday swing.
Intraday charts show prices minute by minute.

cards.def:
The smallest movement in a price
हिंदी: मूल्य में न्यूनतम बदलाव
examples: The system stores every tick for later analysis.
The share price moved up by one tick.
Tick data is huge and expensive to store.
High-frequency traders react to every tick.

cards.def:
The price a seller is willing to accept
हिंदी: विक्रेता का मूल्य
examples: The ask price rose after the news.
The ask for the share was higher than I wanted to pay.
Buyers pay the ask price when they want to trade immediately.
The ask dropped as more sellers came in.

cards.def:
The difference between bid and ask prices
हिंदी: बोली और मांग मूल्य का अंतर
examples: A wide spread signals low liquidity.
Large company shares usually have a narrow spread.
Currency exchange counters make money on the spread.
The spread widened as the market closed.

cards.def:
The completion of a trade through the exchange of money and assets
हिंदी: सौदे का निपटान
examples: Settlement usually occurs one business day after the trade.
Indian stock trades now have T+1 settlement.
Settlement failed because the seller didn't have the shares.
Settlement of the property deal took two weeks.

cards.def:
Confirming and reconciling a trade before settlement
हिंदी: लेन-देन की पुष्टि प्रक्रिया
examples: The clearing house guarantees both sides of the trade.
The clearing process checks both sides of the trade.
Clearing reduces the risk of one side not paying.
Clearing happens before the money moves.

cards.def:
An institution that safeguards financial assets
हिंदी: संपत्तियों का संरक्षक संस्थान
examples: The custodian holds the fund's securities securely.
The custodian keeps the shares safe for the fund.
The fund changed its custodian to cut fees.
Custodians report holdings to investors every month.

cards.def:
The other party in a financial transaction
हिंदी: लेन-देन की दूसरी पार्टी
examples: We assess the counterparty's creditworthiness.
The trade failed because the counterparty didn't pay.
Banks limit how much risk they take with each counterparty.
Check the counterparty's details before sending money.

cards.def:
The ability of a borrower to repay debt
हिंदी: ऋण चुकाने की क्षमता
examples: The agency downgraded the firm's creditworthiness.
Banks check your creditworthiness before giving a loan.
Paying bills on time improves your creditworthiness.
The company's creditworthiness fell after big losses.

cards.def:
An assessment of credit quality
हिंदी: ऋण साख रेटिंग
examples: The bond has a high credit rating.
Check the rating before investing in a company bond.
The rating agency cut the country's rating.
A AAA rating means very low risk.

cards.def:
A transaction to buy or sell an asset
हिंदी: सौदा
examples: The trade was executed at the closing price.
My first trade on the app was buying ten shares.
The trade was cancelled because of a pricing error.
Every trade is recorded for regulators.

cards.def:
A list of buy and sell orders for an asset
हिंदी: खरीद-बिक्री आदेशों की सूची
examples: Depth in the order book shows market interest.
The order book shows more buyers than sellers today.
A thin order book can lead to sharp price moves.
Traders watch the order book before placing big orders.

cards.def:
The amount of an asset held by an investor
हिंदी: किसी संपत्ति की धारित मात्रा
examples: The desk closed its position before the announcement.
He took a large position in the bank's shares.
Reduce your position if you can't afford the risk.
The fund's biggest position is in an IT company.

cards.def:
Assets owned by an investor or fund
हिंदी: धारित संपत्तियाँ
examples: The report lists all the fund's holdings.
Check the fund's holdings before investing.
Her holdings include gold, shares and a flat.
The fund updates its holdings list every month.

cards.def:
The per-share value of a fund after liabilities
हिंदी: शुद्ध संपत्ति मूल्य
examples: Net asset value is calculated after market close.
The net asset value of my fund rose today.
You buy mutual fund units at the day's net asset value.
A low net asset value doesn't mean a fund is cheap.

cards.def:
The total market value of assets a firm manages
हिंदी: प्रबंधन के अंतर्गत कुल संपत्ति
examples: The firm's AUM exceeded two trillion dollars.
The fund house's AUM grew by twenty percent this year.
Bigger AUM doesn't always mean better returns.
The company reports its AUM every quarter.

cards.def:
Having a legal duty to act in a client's best interest
हिंदी: विश्वस्त के रूप में कर्तव्यबद्ध
examples: Advisers have a fiduciary duty to their clients.
A fiduciary must put the client's interests first.
Trustees have a fiduciary duty to the trust's members.
Choose an adviser who acts as a fiduciary.

cards.def:
Professional advice and services for managing a client's finances
हिंदी: संपत्ति प्रबंधन सेवाएँ
examples: The bank expanded its wealth management division.
Wealth management services usually need a minimum investment.
She works in wealth management at a private bank.
Good wealth management includes tax and estate planning.

cards.def:
Having a high level of personal wealth
हिंदी: उच्च निवल संपत्ति वाला
examples: The service targets high-net-worth individuals.
The bank has a special lounge for high-net-worth customers.
High-net-worth families often have a personal adviser.
The number of high-net-worth Indians is growing fast.

cards.def:
An organisation investing large sums on behalf of others
हिंदी: संस्थागत निवेशक
examples: Pension funds are major institutional investors.
Institutional investors bought most of the IPO shares.
Insurance companies are large institutional investors.
Prices moved when institutional investors started selling.

cards.def:
An individual who invests their own money
हिंदी: खुदरा निवेशक
examples: Retail investors increased their trading activity.
Retail investors can now start SIPs from just five hundred rupees.
Many retail investors joined the market during the lockdown.
Rules are designed to protect retail investors.

cards.def:
A category of investments with similar characteristics
हिंदी: संपत्ति वर्ग
examples: Equities and bonds are different asset classes.
Gold is a separate asset class from shares.
Spread your money across more than one asset class.
Real estate was the best asset class last decade.

cards.def:
A fund traded on an exchange that tracks an index
हिंदी: एक्सचेंज पर कारोबार होने वाला फ़ंड
examples: The ETF tracks the top five hundred companies.
A gold ETF lets you invest in gold without buying jewellery.
You can buy an ETF through any trading app.
ETFs usually have lower fees than active funds.

cards.def:
A pooled investment managed by professionals
हिंदी: म्यूचुअल फ़ंड
examples: The mutual fund charges a low annual fee.
I invest in a mutual fund through a monthly SIP.
Read the mutual fund's documents before investing.
The mutual fund gave a twelve percent return last year.

cards.def:
A pooled investment using complex strategies for high returns
हिंदी: हेज फ़ंड
examples: The hedge fund bet against the currency.
Hedge funds are usually open only to wealthy investors.
The hedge fund made money when the market fell.
Hedge funds charge high fees for active management.

cards.def:
A fund designed to match the performance of a market index
हिंदी: सूचकांक आधारित फ़ंड
examples: Index funds offer broad exposure at low cost.
An index fund is a simple choice for new investors.
The index fund tracks the Nifty 50.
Index funds rarely beat the market, but they rarely trail it much.

cards.def:
The annual fee charged as a percentage of fund assets
हिंदी: फ़ंड का वार्षिक शुल्क अनुपात
examples: A lower expense ratio improves long-term returns.
Compare the expense ratio of funds before investing.
Direct plans have a lower expense ratio than regular plans.
An expense ratio of two percent eats into your returns.

cards.def:
Earning returns on both principal and accumulated returns
हिंदी: चक्रवृद्धि
examples: Compounding rewards patient, long-term investors.
Thanks to compounding, small savings grow large over decades.
Start investing early to benefit from compounding.
Compounding works against you on credit card debt too.

cards.def:
A return to growth after a downturn
हिंदी: आर्थिक सुधार
examples: The recovery has been slow but steady.
The tourism industry saw a strong recovery after the pandemic.
Economists expect a recovery in car sales next year.
Her shares lost value, but she waited for the recovery.

cards.def:
A period of rising prices
हिंदी: तेज़ी का बाज़ार
examples: The bull market lasted almost a decade.
Many first-time investors joined during the bull market.
In a bull market, almost every stock seems to rise.
Don't assume the bull market will last forever.

cards.def:
A period of falling prices
हिंदी: मंदी का बाज़ार
examples: Investors panic during a bear market.
Long-term investors see a bear market as a chance to buy.
The bear market wiped out a year of gains.
Stay calm and keep your SIP running during a bear market.

cards.def:
A rapid sale of assets causing falling prices
हिंदी: तेज़ बिकवाली
examples: Fear triggered a broad sell-off in bonds.
The sell-off started after the bad inflation numbers.
Bank shares fell sharply in the sell-off.
Panic selling turned a small dip into a big sell-off.

cards.def:
The overall attitude of investors towards the market
हिंदी: निवेशकों का सामान्य रुझान
examples: Investor sentiment turned cautious.
Positive budget news improved market sentiment.
Consumer sentiment is weak because prices are high.
Social media can shift investor sentiment quickly.

cards.def:
Risky investing in hope of quick profit
हिंदी: जोखिम भरी अटकलबाज़ी
examples: Speculation drove prices far above fundamentals.
Land speculation pushed prices up near the new airport.
Crypto prices are driven mostly by speculation.
The rumour led to wild speculation about a merger.

cards.def:
Basic financial factors that determine an asset's value
हिंदी: बुनियादी आर्थिक कारक
examples: The stock's fundamentals remain strong.
Check a company's fundamentals before buying its shares.
The economy's fundamentals are still strong.
Prices fell even though the fundamentals didn't change.

cards.def:
Priced higher than its worth
हिंदी: अपने मूल्य से अधिक कीमत वाला
examples: Analysts believe the stock is overvalued.
Many people think city flats are overvalued.
The startup was overvalued and lost half its value.
An overvalued currency hurts exporters.

cards.def:
Priced lower than its worth
हिंदी: अपने मूल्य से कम कीमत वाला
examples: The company appears undervalued relative to peers.
Value investors look for undervalued companies.
Her skills are undervalued in her current job.
The share is undervalued after the recent fall.

cards.def:
Profit made by a company
हिंदी: कंपनी की कमाई
examples: Quarterly earnings beat expectations.
Earnings season brings big moves in share prices.
The company's earnings fell because of higher costs.
Investors expect earnings to grow next year.

cards.def:
Ongoing business expenses not tied to a specific product
हिंदी: सामान्य परिचालन खर्च
examples: We reduced overhead costs by consolidating offices.
Rent and electricity are major overhead costs for the shop.
Working remotely cut our overhead costs.
High overhead costs make small orders unprofitable.

cards.def:
The movement of money in and out of a business
हिंदी: नकदी का प्रवाह
examples: Strong cash flow supports the dividend.
Good cash flow lets a business pay salaries on time.
Late customer payments hurt our cash flow.
Track your personal cash flow with a simple spreadsheet.

cards.def:
A statement of a company's assets and liabilities
हिंदी: तुलन पत्र
examples: The balance sheet shows low debt.
Investors study the balance sheet before lending money.
The balance sheet must balance: assets equal liabilities plus equity.
Large debt on the balance sheet worried the rating agency.

cards.def:
An independent examination of financial statements
हिंदी: लेखा परीक्षण रिपोर्ट
examples: The audit report found no material errors.
The audit report is attached to the annual report.
A qualified audit report is a warning sign for investors.
The board discussed the audit report in detail.

cards.def:
A rule made by authority to control behaviour
हिंदी: विनियमन
examples: New regulation increased reporting obligations.
Strict regulation protects bank customers.
The new regulation bans single-use plastic.
Startups often find regulation confusing.

cards.def:
An authority overseeing and enforcing rules
हिंदी: नियामक संस्था
examples: The regulator fined the firm for late reporting.
SEBI is the market regulator in India.
The regulator asked the bank to stop issuing new cards.
Report fraud to the regulator if the company doesn't respond.

cards.def:
A person ensuring a firm follows laws and rules
हिंदी: अनुपालन अधिकारी
examples: The compliance officer reviewed the new policy.
The compliance officer must approve all client communications.
Ask the compliance officer before accepting expensive gifts.
Our compliance officer runs yearly training on rules.

cards.def:
Rules preventing illegally obtained money from entering the system
हिंदी: धनशोधन निरोधक
examples: Anti-money laundering checks apply to all new clients.
Banks report large cash deposits under anti-money laundering rules.
Anti-money laundering training is mandatory for all staff.
The bank was fined for weak anti-money laundering controls.

cards.def:
The process of verifying a client's identity
हिंदी: ग्राहक पहचान सत्यापन
examples: KYC must be completed before opening an account.
Upload your PAN and Aadhaar to complete KYC.
The app blocked my account until I updated my KYC.
KYC rules help prevent fraud and fake accounts.

cards.def:
Detailed investigation of a client or investment
हिंदी: विस्तृत जाँच प्रक्रिया
examples: The due diligence process takes several weeks.
The due diligence process checks the company's legal history.
Our due diligence process includes a site visit.
Skipping the due diligence process led to a bad investment.

cards.def:
The act of revealing information as required
हिंदी: आवश्यक जानकारी का खुलासा
examples: Full disclosure of fees is required by law.
The disclosure of the CEO's salary surprised shareholders.
Disclosure rules require companies to report big losses quickly.
Make a full disclosure of your income in the tax return.

cards.def:
A situation where personal gain may affect duty
हिंदी: हितों का टकराव
examples: Advisers must declare any conflict of interest.
The judge stepped down because of a conflict of interest.
Hiring your cousin creates a conflict of interest.
Declare any conflict of interest before the vote.

cards.def:
Illegal trading based on confidential information
हिंदी: अंदरूनी जानकारी पर कारोबार
examples: Insider trading is a serious criminal offence.
The director was arrested for insider trading.
Employees can't trade the company's shares before results to avoid insider trading.
Regulators use data analysis to catch insider trading.

cards.def:
Environmental, social and governance criteria used to assess investments
हिंदी: पर्यावरण, सामाजिक व शासन मानदंड
examples: ESG factors increasingly influence investment decisions.
The fund only invests in companies with good ESG scores.
ESG reporting is now required for large listed companies.
Young investors care a lot about ESG.

cards.def:
Investing that considers long-term environmental and social impact
हिंदी: टिकाऊ निवेश
examples: Sustainable investing attracted record inflows.
Sustainable investing avoids companies that harm the environment.
Many banks now offer sustainable investing options.
Sustainable investing doesn't have to mean lower returns.

cards.def:
Responsible management of entrusted assets
हिंदी: ज़िम्मेदार प्रबंधन
examples: Investors expect strong stewardship from asset managers.
Good stewardship means voting on company decisions responsibly.
The trust's stewardship of the old temple is admired.
The new CEO promised careful stewardship of company funds.

cards.def:
Measured after taking the level of risk into account
हिंदी: जोखिम के अनुसार समायोजित
examples: Risk-adjusted returns tell a fuller story.
Compare funds on a risk-adjusted basis, not just returns.
The Sharpe ratio measures risk-adjusted performance.
Her fund has the best risk-adjusted returns in its category.

cards.def:
Returns above those of a benchmark
हिंदी: मानक से अधिक अतिरिक्त प्रतिफल
examples: The manager has consistently generated alpha.
Index funds don't try to generate alpha.
Finding alpha is harder as markets become more efficient.
The fund's alpha disappeared after the star manager left.

cards.def:
A measure of how much an asset moves with the market
हिंदी: बाज़ार के साथ चाल का माप
examples: A beta above one means higher volatility than the market.
Utility stocks usually have a low beta.
A beta of zero point eight means the stock moves less than the market.
High beta stocks rise and fall faster than the index.

cards.def:
The decline from a portfolio's peak to its low
हिंदी: शीर्ष से गिरावट
examples: The maximum drawdown was fifteen percent.
The drawdown during the crash tested investors' patience.
Check a fund's worst drawdown before investing.
It took two years to recover from that drawdown.

cards.def:
Simulating extreme conditions to test resilience
हिंदी: चरम परिस्थितियों का अनुकरण परीक्षण
examples: Banks must pass annual stress tests.
We ran a stress test on our budget assuming no income for six months.
The stress test showed the bank could survive a recession.
Stress test results are published by the central bank.

cards.def:
Evaluating outcomes under different assumed conditions
हिंदी: विभिन्न परिस्थितियों में नतीजों का विश्लेषण
examples: Scenario analysis shows how losses change if rates rise.
Scenario analysis helped us plan for a weak monsoon.
The CFO presented a scenario analysis with three cases.
Use scenario analysis before making big investments.

cards.def:
An estimate of the potential loss over a period
हिंदी: संभावित अधिकतम हानि अनुमान
examples: The model estimates value at risk at ninety-five percent confidence.
The risk team reports value at risk every morning.
Value at risk doesn't show how bad the worst day could be.
Traders must stay within their value at risk limits.

cards.def:
The risk of rare but extreme events
हिंदी: दुर्लभ पर गंभीर घटना का जोखिम
examples: Tail risk is easy to ignore until it happens.
Insurance protects families from tail risk.
The fund lost heavily because it ignored tail risk.
Tail risk events are rare, but they can wipe out years of gains.

cards.def:
An unpredictable event with severe consequences
हिंदी: अप्रत्याशित बड़ी घटना
examples: The pandemic was a classic black swan event.
Nobody predicted that black swan event.
Keep an emergency fund for black swan moments in life.
Some investors buy protection against a black swan crash.

cards.def:
The risk that the failure of one entity collapses the system
हिंदी: तंत्रगत जोखिम
examples: Regulators monitor systemic risk in large banks.
Large banks are watched closely because of systemic risk.
The failure of one big lender created systemic risk.
Regulators set extra capital rules to reduce systemic risk.

cards.def:
The spread of financial trouble from one market to another
हिंदी: संकट का फैलना
examples: Fears of contagion hit neighbouring economies.
Contagion from the US crisis spread to Asian markets.
The central bank acted quickly to stop contagion.
Fear of contagion pushed down other bank shares.

cards.def:
Financial rescue of a failing company
हिंदी: वित्तीय बचाव पैकेज
examples: The government arranged a bailout for the bank.
Taxpayers were angry about the bailout of the airline.
The company asked the government for a bailout.
A bailout came with strict conditions.

cards.def:
The inability to pay debts
हिंदी: दिवालियापन
examples: The company filed for insolvency after losing its biggest client.
The builder's insolvency left many flat buyers stranded.
The court began insolvency proceedings against the company.
Insolvency laws help creditors recover some of their money.

cards.def:
To reorganise finances or operations
हिंदी: पुनर्गठन करना
examples: The company restructured its debt to avoid default.
The company restructured its teams after the merger.
We restructured the loan to lower the monthly payment.
The bank plans to restructure its branch network.

cards.def:
Merging of companies or financial statements
हिंदी: समेकन
examples: Industry consolidation reduced the number of vendors.
Consolidation in the telecom sector left only a few players.
The finance team handles consolidation of subsidiary accounts.
Bank consolidation created fewer but stronger banks.

cards.def:
Selling off assets or business units
हिंदी: संपत्ति की बिक्री
examples: The divestment of the unit raised two billion dollars.
The government announced divestment of its stake in two companies.
Divestment helped the company focus on its core business.
Students called for divestment from coal companies.

cards.def:
Money or assets used to generate income
हिंदी: पूँजी
examples: The startup raised capital from investors.
Starting a restaurant needs a lot of capital.
The bank must keep enough capital to cover losses.
She used her savings as starting capital for the shop.

cards.def:
Spending on long-term assets
हिंदी: दीर्घकालिक संपत्ति पर खर्च
examples: Capital expenditure rose due to new data centres.
Buying new trucks is a capital expenditure.
The government increased capital expenditure on railways.
Capital expenditure is planned years in advance.

cards.def:
Ongoing cost of running a business
हिंदी: परिचालन व्यय
examples: Cloud usage is a major operating expense.
Salaries are the biggest operating expense for our company.
Moving to the cloud turned hardware costs into an operating expense.
Cut operating expenses without hurting customer service.

cards.def:
An estimate of future figures based on current trends
हिंदी: अनुमानित आँकड़ा
examples: Revenue projections look conservative.
The sales projection for next year looks too optimistic.
Population projections help cities plan schools.
Our projection assumes no change in fuel prices.

cards.def:
The difference between planned and actual figures
हिंदी: योजना और वास्तविकता का अंतर
examples: The variance in costs was mainly due to licences.
Explain any variance above five percent in the monthly report.
The variance was due to an unexpected repair bill.
There was a positive variance because sales beat the plan.

cards.def:
The point at which income equals costs
हिंदी: लाभ-हानि रहित बिंदु
examples: The product should reach break-even within a year.
The cafe hopes to break even by the end of the year.
We need two hundred customers a month to reach break-even.
Break-even analysis helps set the right price.

cards.def:
A measure of profit relative to cost
हिंदी: निवेश पर प्रतिफल
examples: The automation had a strong return on investment.
Training staff gave a high return on investment.
Calculate the return on investment before buying the machine.
The marketing campaign had a poor return on investment.

cards.def:
Comparing the costs of an action with its benefits
हिंदी: लागत-लाभ विश्लेषण
examples: A cost-benefit analysis supported the upgrade.
We did a cost-benefit analysis before buying the new software.
A cost-benefit analysis showed solar panels pay off in five years.
The government ran a cost-benefit analysis of the new highway.

cards.def:
The process of acquiring goods or services
हिंदी: ख़रीद प्रक्रिया
examples: Procurement approved the new vendor contract.
Procurement takes three weeks to approve new laptops.
The procurement team negotiated a better price.
Government procurement rules are very strict.

cards.def:
A company that supplies goods or services
हिंदी: विक्रेता / आपूर्तिकर्ता
examples: We onboard a new data vendor every month.
The vendor delivered the furniture two days late.
We compare at least three vendors before signing.
Pay the vendor only after checking the goods.

cards.def:
Relating to a legally binding agreement
हिंदी: अनुबंध संबंधी
examples: Late delivery is a contractual breach.
We have a contractual duty to protect client data.
The contractual notice period is three months.
Check the contractual terms before agreeing to changes.

cards.def:
A contract term imposing a fine for breaching conditions
हिंदी: दंड खंड
examples: The penalty clause applies if delivery is late.
The builder had to pay under the penalty clause for the delay.
Negotiate the penalty clause before signing.
There's no penalty clause, so the vendor has no reason to hurry.

cards.def:
Power to influence the terms of a deal
हिंदी: वार्ता में बढ़त
examples: Multiple vendors give us stronger negotiating leverage.
Having another job offer gave her negotiating leverage.
Large orders give us negotiating leverage with suppliers.
We lost negotiating leverage after the deadline passed.

cards.def:
Extension of a contract or licence for another period
हिंदी: नवीनीकरण
examples: The licence renewal is due in April.
My car insurance renewal is due next week.
The software renewal price went up by twenty percent.
Set reminders for every contract renewal date.

cards.def:
Official permission to use something
हिंदी: लाइसेंस
examples: The licence limits usage to ten users.
You need a licence to open a restaurant.
The company bought a licence for the design software.
His driving licence expires next year.

cards.def:
Pricing that varies by usage or level
हिंदी: स्तरवार मूल्य निर्धारण
examples: Tiered pricing makes the service cheaper at higher volumes.
The mobile plan uses tiered pricing based on data use.
With tiered pricing, big customers pay less per unit.
Electricity bills use tiered pricing in many states.

cards.def:
A price reduction for large purchases
हिंदी: अधिक मात्रा पर छूट
examples: We negotiated a volume discount from the vendor.
The office got a volume discount on fifty new chairs.
Wholesale shops offer a volume discount on rice.
Ask for a volume discount if you order every month.

cards.def:
A graph of bond yields across different maturities
हिंदी: परिपक्वता के अनुसार बॉन्ड प्रतिफल का ग्राफ़
examples: An inverted yield curve often signals a slowdown.
Analysts watch the yield curve for signs of recession.
A steep yield curve usually means growth ahead.
The yield curve flattened after the rate decision.

cards.def:
One hundredth of one percent
हिंदी: एक प्रतिशत का सौवाँ भाग
examples: The bank raised rates by fifty basis points.
My home loan rate went up by twenty-five basis points.
The bond yield rose ten basis points today.
A few basis points make a big difference on a large loan.

cards.def:
Government debt securities or finance department
हिंदी: सरकारी प्रतिभूतियाँ / कोषागार
examples: Investors moved money into treasuries.
US treasury bonds are seen as very safe.
The company's treasury team manages its cash.
Treasury bills are short-term government debt.

cards.def:
Money borrowed by a national government
हिंदी: सरकारी ऋण
examples: Sovereign debt worries unsettled markets.
The country's sovereign debt is now larger than its GDP.
Rating agencies review sovereign debt every year.
Banks hold a lot of sovereign debt as safe assets.

cards.def:
The yield difference between corporate and government bonds
हिंदी: कॉर्पोरेट व सरकारी बॉन्ड के प्रतिफल का अंतर
examples: Credit spreads widened during the crisis.
A narrow credit spread means investors feel confident.
The company's credit spread jumped after weak results.
Watch credit spreads as a signal of market stress.

cards.def:
Bonds with a low risk of default
हिंदी: कम जोखिम वाले बॉन्ड वर्ग का
examples: The fund only buys investment grade bonds.
Pension funds usually buy only investment grade bonds.
The company lost its investment grade status.
Investment grade bonds pay lower interest but are safer.

cards.def:
A high-risk, high-yield bond
हिंदी: उच्च जोखिम वाला बॉन्ड
examples: Junk bonds pay more but carry default risk.
The company had to issue junk bonds to raise money.
Junk bond yields rose as recession fears grew.
Don't put your retirement savings in junk bonds.

cards.def:
A market where shares are traded
हिंदी: शेयर बाज़ार
examples: Equity markets rallied after the announcement.
The equity market fell sharply after the election result.
Foreign investors returned to the Indian equity market.
The equity market is risky in the short term.

cards.def:
A large, reliable, well-established company
हिंदी: बड़ी व भरोसेमंद कंपनी
examples: Blue chip stocks suit cautious investors.
My father only invests in blue chip companies.
Blue chip shares fell less during the crash.
Reliance and TCS are often called blue chip stocks.

cards.def:
The total market value of a company's shares
हिंदी: कंपनी का कुल बाज़ार मूल्य
examples: Its market capitalisation exceeds one trillion dollars.
The company's market capitalisation doubled in two years.
Funds group shares by market capitalisation: large, mid and small.
Market capitalisation changes every time the share price moves.

cards.def:
The first sale of a company's shares to the public
हिंदी: कंपनी के शेयरों की पहली सार्वजनिक बिक्री
examples: The start-up plans an initial public offering next year.
The initial public offering was oversubscribed fifty times.
Employees made money when the company held its initial public offering.
Read the details before applying for an initial public offering.

cards.def:
A company repurchasing its own shares
हिंदी: कंपनी द्वारा अपने शेयर वापस ख़रीदना
examples: The share buyback lifted the stock price.
The share buyback shows the company has extra cash.
Investors liked the share buyback announcement.
Some critics say a share buyback is better spent on growth.

cards.def:
A market where securities are bought and sold
हिंदी: स्टॉक एक्सचेंज
examples: The stock exchange closes at three-thirty.
The Bombay Stock Exchange is one of Asia's oldest.
The company is listed on two stock exchanges.
The stock exchange halted trading after the big fall.

cards.def:
Adjusting an index's holdings to match rules
हिंदी: सूचकांक की संरचना में समायोजन
examples: Index rebalancing triggered heavy trading.
Index rebalancing happens every six months for the Nifty.
Shares added in index rebalancing often rise beforehand.
Index funds must trade on the day of index rebalancing.

cards.def:
The difference between a fund's and its benchmark's returns
हिंदी: फ़ंड और मानक के प्रतिफल का अंतर
examples: Low tracking error indicates faithful replication.
A good index fund has very low tracking error.
High fees increase tracking error over time.
The ETF's tracking error was higher than expected last year.

cards.def:
Investing to match a market index rather than beat it
हिंदी: सूचकांक के बराबर निवेश
examples: Passive investing has grown rapidly.
Passive investing suits people who don't want to pick stocks.
Passive investing keeps costs very low.
The rise of passive investing changed the fund industry.

cards.def:
Choosing investments to try to beat the market
हिंदी: सक्रिय रूप से निवेश चुनना
examples: Active management charges higher fees.
Active management works better in less efficient markets.
She believes active management is worth the higher fee.
The fund's active management beat the index this year.

cards.def:
A firm that provides buy and sell quotes to ensure liquidity
हिंदी: क्रय-विक्रय भाव देने वाली संस्था
examples: Market makers keep spreads narrow.
The market maker quotes prices for the small company's shares.
Without a market maker, the option would be hard to trade.
Market makers earn money from the bid-ask spread.

cards.def:
A private venue for trading large blocks of shares
हिंदी: बड़े सौदों के लिए निजी मंच
examples: Large orders often route through dark pools.
Dark pools let big funds trade without moving the price.
Regulators want more transparency in dark pools.
The block of shares was sold in a dark pool.

cards.def:
Very fast automated trading using algorithms
हिंदी: तेज़ गति से स्वचालित ट्रेडिंग
examples: High-frequency trading depends on microsecond latency.
High-frequency trading firms place their servers near the exchange.
Critics say high-frequency trading hurts small investors.
High-frequency trading makes thousands of trades in a second.

cards.def:
Trading using automated rules
हिंदी: एल्गोरिदम आधारित ट्रेडिंग
examples: Algorithmic trading now dominates equity volume.
Algorithmic trading reacts to news faster than any human.
A bug in algorithmic trading caused huge losses in minutes.
Many brokers now offer algorithmic trading to retail clients.

cards.def:
The difference between expected and actual trade price
हिंदी: अपेक्षित व वास्तविक सौदा मूल्य का अंतर
examples: Slippage rose during the volatile open.
Use limit orders to avoid slippage.
Slippage is common when you trade small, illiquid shares.
The slippage cost us more than the brokerage fee.

cards.def:
A demand to add funds to cover losses
हिंदी: नुक़सान की भरपाई हेतु अतिरिक्त धन की माँग
examples: He faced a margin call after the sharp fall.
The broker sent a margin call when the shares fell.
If you can't meet the margin call, your position is sold.
Borrowing to trade can lead to a margin call.

cards.def:
Selling borrowed assets expecting prices to fall
हिंदी: उधार लेकर बेचना, गिरावट की उम्मीद में
examples: Short selling can increase market volatility.
Short selling was banned temporarily during the crisis.
Short selling is risky because losses have no limit.
The report triggered heavy short selling of the company's shares.

cards.def:
Owning an asset expecting its price to rise
हिंदी: कीमत बढ़ने की उम्मीद में धारित स्थिति
examples: The fund holds a long position in energy stocks.
She opened a long position in gold before the festival season.
A long position profits when the price goes up.
The trader closed his long position after the rally.

cards.def:
Profiting from price differences in different markets
हिंदी: मूल्य अंतर से लाभ कमाना
examples: Arbitrage keeps prices aligned across exchanges.
Arbitrage opportunities disappear quickly in modern markets.
Some funds use arbitrage between the cash and futures markets.
He made a small profit through currency arbitrage.

cards.def:
Valuing assets at current market prices
हिंदी: वर्तमान बाज़ार मूल्य पर मूल्यांकन
examples: Positions are marked to market every evening.
Mark-to-market losses showed up in the bank's quarterly results.
Futures accounts are settled mark-to-market every day.
Mark-to-market accounting reflects current values.

cards.def:
The provider from which a price is taken
हिंदी: मूल्य का स्रोत
examples: We define a primary and fallback pricing source.
Use the exchange as the pricing source for listed shares.
The bond's pricing source changed last month.
Document the pricing source for every instrument.

cards.def:
A price that has not been updated recently
हिंदी: पुराना न बदला हुआ मूल्य
examples: A stale price distorted the portfolio valuation.
The system flags a stale price if it hasn't changed in two days.
A stale price made the fund look better than it was.
Replace any stale price before publishing the report.

cards.def:
The permitted variation before a price is flagged
हिंदी: मूल्य में स्वीकार्य अंतर
examples: The check flags moves beyond the price tolerance.
A price move above the price tolerance needs manual review.
We set a tighter price tolerance for government bonds.
Too wide a price tolerance can let bad prices through.

cards.def:
The permission to use a data vendor's information
हिंदी: डेटा विक्रेता की जानकारी उपयोग की अनुमति
examples: Vendor entitlement limits which teams can see raw feeds.
Request vendor entitlement before you access the price feed.
Vendor entitlement is checked every time a user opens the report.
The audit found users without the right vendor entitlement.

cards.def:
Legal permission to use specific data
हिंदी: डेटा उपयोग की क़ानूनी अनुमति
examples: The data licence restricts redistribution.
Our data licence allows internal use only.
The data licence costs more for every extra user.
Legal reviewed the data licence before we signed.

cards.def:
The price of one currency in terms of another
हिंदी: विनिमय दर
examples: The exchange rate moved against the rupee.
Check the exchange rate before you travel abroad.
A weak exchange rate makes imports more expensive.
The airport offers a poor exchange rate.

cards.def:
Reducing risk from currency movements
हिंदी: मुद्रा जोखिम से बचाव
examples: Currency hedging protects overseas returns.
Currency hedging costs money but reduces surprises.
The exporter uses currency hedging for its dollar income.
Some international funds skip currency hedging.

cards.def:
The market for trading national currencies
हिंदी: विदेशी मुद्रा बाज़ार
examples: Foreign exchange trading runs around the clock.
Banks earn fees from foreign exchange transactions.
The RBI manages India's foreign exchange reserves.
Foreign exchange rates change every few seconds.

cards.def:
A currency held widely by central banks
हिंदी: आरक्षित मुद्रा
examples: The dollar is the main reserve currency.
As the reserve currency, the dollar is used in most oil trade.
Some countries want a new reserve currency.
Being a reserve currency gives a country economic power.

cards.def:
Government-issued money not backed by a physical commodity
हिंदी: सरकार द्वारा जारी मुद्रा
examples: Most modern money is fiat currency.
The rupee is a fiat currency.
Fiat currency gets its value from trust in the government.
Some people buy gold because they distrust fiat currency.

cards.def:
Central bank purchasing assets to increase money supply
हिंदी: केंद्रीय बैंक द्वारा मुद्रा आपूर्ति बढ़ाने की प्रक्रिया
examples: Quantitative easing lowered long-term rates.
Quantitative easing pushed up the prices of shares and bonds.
The central bank ended quantitative easing last year.
Critics say quantitative easing increased inequality.

cards.def:
An increase in interest rates
हिंदी: ब्याज दर में वृद्धि
examples: A rate hike cooled the housing market.
The rate hike made my home loan EMI go up.
Markets fell after the surprise rate hike.
Another rate hike is expected next month.

cards.def:
Slowing inflation without causing recession
हिंदी: मंदी के बिना महँगाई घटाना
examples: Policymakers aim for a soft landing.
The economy achieved a soft landing after years of high inflation.
Investors hope for a soft landing, not a recession.
A soft landing is hard to achieve.

cards.def:
A sharp economic downturn after tightening
हिंदी: तीव्र आर्थिक गिरावट
examples: A hard landing would hurt employment.
A hard landing could lead to job losses.
Economists warned of a hard landing if rates rose too fast.
China's slowdown raised fears of a hard landing.

cards.def:
A sudden reduction in available loans
हिंदी: ऋण उपलब्धता में अचानक कमी
examples: The credit crunch froze lending.
During the credit crunch, even good businesses couldn't get loans.
The credit crunch hit small companies the hardest.
Banks became very careful after the credit crunch.

cards.def:
A shortage of cash or easily sellable assets
हिंदी: नकदी का संकट
examples: A liquidity crisis forced the fund to halt withdrawals.
The company had profits but still faced a liquidity crisis.
A liquidity crisis can turn into a solvency crisis.
The central bank lent money to stop the liquidity crisis.

cards.def:
A rush of customers withdrawing money
हिंदी: बैंक से एक साथ पैसे निकालने की भीड़
examples: Rumours triggered a run on the bank.
Deposit insurance helps prevent a run on the bank.
Long queues outside branches showed a run on the bank.
Social media spread panic and started a run on the bank.

cards.def:
So large that its collapse would harm the economy
हिंदी: इतना बड़ा कि गिरने नहीं दिया जा सकता
examples: Regulators fear banks that are too big to fail.
Some say no bank should be too big to fail.
Because it was too big to fail, the government rescued it.
Too big to fail banks face extra capital rules.

cards.def:
Taking risks because someone else bears the cost
हिंदी: दूसरे के जोखिम उठाने की वजह से लापरवाही
examples: Bailouts can create moral hazard.
Free insurance for reckless drivers would create moral hazard.
Moral hazard appears when people don't pay for their mistakes.
Regulators worry that bailouts create moral hazard.

cards.def:
An asset expected to hold value in turbulent times
हिंदी: मुश्किल समय में सुरक्षित निवेश
examples: Gold is considered a safe haven.
Investors rushed to gold as a safe haven.
The Swiss franc is seen as a safe haven currency.
Government bonds acted as a safe haven during the crash.

cards.def:
Investors moving money to safer assets
हिंदी: सुरक्षित संपत्तियों की ओर पलायन
examples: There was a flight to quality as fears grew.
The flight to quality pushed bond yields down.
During the flight to quality, small company shares fell the most.
A flight to quality usually strengthens the dollar.

cards.def:
Market mood in which investors avoid risk
हिंदी: जोखिम से बचने का बाज़ार रुझान
examples: It was a risk-off day for equities.
On risk-off days, investors buy gold and bonds.
War news created a risk-off mood in markets.
Risk-off selling hit emerging markets hard.

cards.def:
Market mood in which investors seek higher returns
हिंदी: जोखिम उठाने का बाज़ार रुझान
examples: Risk-on sentiment pushed tech stocks higher.
Good economic data created a risk-on mood.
In risk-on markets, small company shares tend to rally.
Risk-on trading pushed the Nifty to a new high.

cards.def:
Factors making progress more difficult
हिंदी: प्रतिकूल परिस्थितियाँ
examples: The sector faces regulatory headwinds.
High oil prices are a headwind for airlines.
The company faces headwinds from rising costs.
Despite headwinds, sales grew by ten percent.

cards.def:
Factors helping progress
हिंदी: अनुकूल परिस्थितियाँ
examples: Lower rates provided tailwinds for growth.
Strong demand is a tailwind for the car industry.
Government spending gave tailwinds to construction companies.
A weaker rupee is a tailwind for IT exporters.

cards.def:
Borrowing in a low-interest currency to invest in a higher-yielding one
हिंदी: कम ब्याज में उधार लेकर अधिक ब्याज वाली मुद्रा में निवेश
examples: The carry trade unwound sharply when rates changed.
The carry trade borrows yen and invests in higher-yielding currencies.
Carry trade profits disappear when currencies move sharply.
A sudden rate hike can unwind the carry trade.

cards.def:
The total return of a bond if held until it matures
हिंदी: परिपक्वता तक रखने पर बॉन्ड का कुल प्रतिफल
examples: The yield to maturity is higher than the coupon rate.
Compare bonds by yield to maturity, not just the coupon.
The yield to maturity falls when the bond price rises.
Brokers show the yield to maturity for each bond.
